author_score_policy: Display only; never use for risk, automation, thresholds, ranking prediction, or composite scoring.

factors.name: URL Accessibility
factors.definition: The public URL is fetchable without authentication or technical barriers.

factors.name: Search Rank
factors.definition: Externally observed search position; no evidence is no-data.

factors.name: Fan-out Rank
factors.definition: Externally supplied position across expanded/fan-out queries; never estimate.

factors.name: Preview Control
factors.definition: Snippet and preview directives are observed but never auto-modified.

factors.name: Query-Answer Match
factors.definition: Visible page information directly addresses the tested query.

factors.name: Intent-Format Match
factors.definition: The content form matches the buyer intent without keyword stuffing.

factors.name: Topic Cluster Ranking
factors.definition: Externally evidenced cluster performance; no internal guess.

factors.name: Answer Near the Top
factors.definition: A factual answer appears early in main content.

factors.name: AI-ready Structure
factors.definition: Headings, lists, tables and definitions expose information clearly.

factors.name: Factually Specific
factors.definition: Specific claims are present and supported by trusted sources.

factors.name: Explicit Phrasing
factors.definition: Ambiguous references are reduced without removing qualifiers or creating absolutes.

factors.name: Cites Sources
factors.definition: The page links to relevant sources where appropriate.

factors.name: Self-contained Passages
factors.definition: Key passages remain understandable out of context.

factors.name: Content Visibility
factors.definition: Important text is present in visible HTML rather than hidden or gated.

factors.name: Freshness
factors.definition: Real review/update evidence only; fake timestamps are forbidden.

factors.name: Brand / Entity Trust
factors.definition: External entity evidence only; never infer trust from author score.

factors.name: Length
factors.definition: Descriptive content length only; never triggers expansion by itself.

factors.name: Language
factors.definition: Language and locale are internally consistent.

factors.name: Entity Consistency
factors.definition: Brand and product entities agree across visible text and structured data.

factors.name: Structured Data
factors.definition: Truthful parseable structured data; low score never triggers deletion.

factors.name: Known Source
factors.definition: Externally evidenced source recognition only.

factors.name: Domain Authority
factors.definition: Third-party metric import only; no evidence is no-data.

factors.name: LLMs.txt
factors.definition: Presence and accuracy are observed; never delete or create solely because of the author score.
